title: FastSK: Fast Sequence Analysis with Gapped String Kernels

run_setup.reason: The README runs `cd results/ && python run_gridsearch.py`; the script opens spreadsheets/datasets_to_use.csv relative to its working directory. The datasets are in the repository.
open_items: The script imports `fastsk`, a C++ extension built from the repository (`pip install .`). PyPI has no Linux wheel (0.0.1 and 0.0.2: macOS wheels and sdists only). Building needs a C++ compiler, which the sandbox image does not have, and runs package code in the install phase, which the sandbox does not allow today. Both are owner decisions.

requirements.txt pins python-dateutil==2.8.1 while leaving pandas unpinned; recent pandas needs python-dateutil>=2.8.2, so the requirements conflict (Pilot 1). Resolving it means choosing a pandas version the repository does not name.
